title: rust/lichen-link/tests/key_generation.rs pins rejected IID-embedding address for seed 000102..1f key
description: Found during 0qcc review (lci_identity.json migration). rust/lichen-link/tests/key_generation.rs:103,124 hardcode ygg_addr_from_pubkey == 02ed4242ead4ac69ed4242ead4ac6948 for the seed 000102..1f Ed25519 key (pubkey 03a107bff3ce10be1d70dd18e74bc09967e4d6309ba50d5f1ddc8664125531b8). That address embeds the SHA-512 IID in the lower 64 bits = the REJECTED lichen-native profile (settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision). Correct upstream AddrForKey value, derived by an independent reimplementation validated byte-for-byte against the genuine upstream Go anchor in test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json (bdbacfd8... -> 0200848a...) and 8 other full-length anchors: 02062f7c200618f7a0f14791738c5a1f (206:2f7c:2006:18f7:a0f1:4791:738c:5a1f). Python lci_identity.json now pins this value; Rust test disagrees with Python on identical input until fixed. Same stale-fixture class as 1p2r.4 / wta9.
close_reason: Already fixed on main before this bead was filed (finding was gathered from a worker branch 190 commits behind main). main:rust/lichen-link/tests/key_generation.rs:105,127 pin hex16("02062f7c200618f7a0f14791738c5a1f") = upstream AddrForKey for pubkey 03a107bf...5531b8 - exactly the value this bead prescribed (independently derived and validated against the yggdrasil_address.json anchors). No code change needed; closing as no-op/already-done.
